definitions.en: possible to imagine, believe, or suppose

example.en: There is no conceivable reason to delay the repair.
example.zh: 没有任何可想象的理由推迟维修。

morphemes.note: The spelling keeps the conceive family visible before -able.

learning.coreIdea: 能够被头脑接纳、想象或认为可能。
learning.memoryHook: conceivable = able to be conceived in the mind。
learning.watchOut: conceivable 是可想象/可能；conceited 是自负；perceivable 是可感知。

definitions.en: to form an idea, plan, image, or possibility in the mind

example.en: The architect conceived a library filled with natural light.
example.zh: 建筑师构想了一座充满自然光的图书馆。

definitions.en: to become pregnant with a child

example.en: They had been trying to conceive for several months.
example.zh: 他们已经尝试受孕几个月了。

definitions.en: to understand, imagine, or think of something as possible

example.en: It is hard to conceive of a fair solution without compromise.
example.zh: 没有妥协，很难想象一个公平的解决方案。

morphemes.note: In Latin concipere, con- is often explained as an intensive or together-with prefix.
From Latin concipere, built from con- plus a combining form of capere.

learning.coreIdea: 把东西接进身体或头脑里，并在那里形成、保有。
learning.memoryHook: con + ceive = take in and hold：身体里形成生命，头脑里形成想法。
learning.watchOut: conceive 是构想/受孕；receive 是收到；concept 是已经形成的概念名词。

definitions.en: the act or process of forming an idea in the mind

example.en: The project changed between conception and launch.
example.zh: 这个项目从构想到发布之间发生了变化。

definitions.en: an idea, understanding, or way of thinking about something

example.en: Her conception of leadership emphasizes service.
example.zh: 她对领导力的理解强调服务。

definitions.en: the beginning of pregnancy

example.en: The doctor explained the early stages after conception.
example.zh: 医生解释了受孕后的早期阶段。

morphemes.note: From Latin conceptionem/conceptio, built on the past-participle stem of concipere.

learning.coreIdea: 构想、理解或受孕这个形成过程本身。
learning.memoryHook: conception = the act/result of conceiving：一个想法或生命开始形成。
learning.watchOut: conception 是形成过程或观念；concept 是较固定的概念；contraception 是防止受孕。

definitions.en: to build or put parts together

example.en: Engineers construct a bridge from many smaller parts.
example.zh: 工程师用许多小部件建造一座桥。

learning.coreIdea: 把部件放到一起形成结构。
learning.watchOut: construct 强调建造；constitute 强调构成。

definitions.en: to damage or destroy a structure

example.en: The device is designed to self-destruct.
example.zh: 这个装置被设计为自毁。

learning.memoryHook: de 把 struct 拆下来。
learning.watchOut: destruct 较正式或技术化；destroy 更常用。

definitions.en: to carry people or goods from one place to another

example.en: Trains transport passengers across the city.
example.zh: 火车把乘客运送穿过城市。

learning.watchOut: transport 偏运输；transfer 偏转移位置或权限。

definitions.en: to bring goods or data into a place or system

example.en: The company imports coffee from Brazil.
example.zh: 这家公司从巴西进口咖啡。

learning.watchOut: import 和 important 形近但词源路径不同。

definitions.en: to send goods or data out of a place or system

example.en: The app can export your notes as a PDF.
example.zh: 这个应用可以把笔记导出为 PDF。

learning.watchOut: export 是输出；exploit 是利用或剥削。

definitions.en: kind and wishing to do good

example.en: The fund was created by a benevolent donor.
example.zh: 这项基金由一位仁慈的捐赠者创立。

learning.watchOut: benevolent 是态度仁慈；beneficial 是结果有益。

definitions.en: having or showing a wish to harm others

example.en: The rumor had a malevolent purpose.
example.zh: 这个谣言带有恶意目的。

learning.watchOut: malevolent 强调意图；malignant 常用于恶性或有害性质。

definitions.en: a person who gives help, especially money

example.en: The school thanked its benefactor publicly.
example.zh: 学校公开感谢了它的捐助者。

morphemes.note: agent suffix placeholder until suffix catalog is expanded

learning.watchOut: benefactor 给帮助；beneficiary 接受好处。

definitions.en: to make goods, often in large quantities

example.en: The factory manufactures medical equipment.
example.zh: 这家工厂制造医疗设备。

learning.coreIdea: 从手工制作引申为工业制造。
learning.watchOut: manufacture 强调生产过程；produce 更宽泛。

definitions.en: an object made by humans, often of historical interest

example.en: The museum displayed an ancient artifact.
example.zh: 博物馆展出了一件古代文物。

learning.watchOut: artifact 是人工制品；article 是文章或物品。

definitions.en: to say words for someone to write down or to command

example.en: The policy will dictate how data is stored.
example.zh: 这项政策将决定数据如何存储。

learning.watchOut: dictate 是命令/口述；dedicate 是奉献。

definitions.en: to say what will happen before it happens

example.en: The model predicts tomorrow's demand.
example.zh: 这个模型预测明天的需求。

learning.watchOut: predict 是预测；predicate 是语法谓语或断言。

definitions.en: to say the opposite of something or be inconsistent with it

example.en: The second report contradicts the first.
example.zh: 第二份报告与第一份报告矛盾。

learning.watchOut: contradict 是矛盾/反驳；contrast 是对比。

definitions.en: an impressive public sight or display

example.en: The parade was a colorful spectacle.
example.zh: 游行是一场色彩斑斓的壮观景象。

learning.watchOut: spectacle 可指场面；spectacles 可指眼镜。

definitions.en: to look at something carefully

example.en: The technician inspected the engine.
example.zh: 技术员检查了发动机。

learning.watchOut: inspect 是检查；expect 是期待。

definitions.en: to regard someone or something with care or honor

example.en: Good teams respect different opinions.
example.zh: 好的团队尊重不同意见。

learning.watchOut: respectful 是恭敬的；respective 是各自的。

definitions.en: able to be seen

example.en: The mountain is visible from the window.
example.zh: 从窗户可以看见那座山。

morphemes.note: suffix placeholder until suffix catalog is expanded

learning.memoryHook: vis + ible = able to be seen。
learning.watchOut: visible 是可见；visual 是视觉的。

definitions.en: to review and change or study again

example.en: She revised the essay after feedback.
example.zh: 她根据反馈修订了文章。

learning.watchOut: revise 常含修改；review 可只是回顾。

definitions.en: to force something or someone out

example.en: The pilot ejected from the aircraft.
example.zh: 飞行员从飞机中弹射出来。

learning.watchOut: eject 可指弹出；evict 常指依法驱逐。

definitions.en: to put something into something else, often by force

example.en: The nurse injected the medicine carefully.
example.zh: 护士小心地注射了药物。

learning.watchOut: inject 常带压力或进入内部；insert 是插入。

definitions.en: a planned task, or to throw forward, display, or estimate

example.en: The team will project sales for next year.
example.zh: 团队将预测明年的销售额。

learning.coreIdea: 把东西向前抛出，引申为计划或投影。
learning.watchOut: project 作名词重音通常在前；作动词重音通常在后。

definitions.en: to send information, signals, or disease from one place to another

example.en: Satellites transmit signals around the world.
example.zh: 卫星向全球传输信号。

learning.watchOut: transmit 强调发送信号/疾病；transfer 强调转移。

definitions.en: to send away or refuse to consider

example.en: The judge dismissed the case.
example.zh: 法官驳回了这个案件。

morphemes.note: dis prefix to be split into its own root in a later schema pass

learning.watchOut: dismiss 不是 miss 的简单加强，而是 send away。

definitions.en: to allow, or an official document allowing something

example.en: The city issued a parking permit.
example.zh: 市政府签发了一张停车许可证。

learning.watchOut: permit 作名词和动词重音可能不同。

definitions.en: to sign up for or agree with an idea

example.en: Many readers subscribe to the newsletter.
example.zh: 许多读者订阅这份通讯。

learning.coreIdea: 在下面签名，后来变成订阅或赞同。
learning.watchOut: subscribe to 可表示订阅，也可表示赞同观点。

definitions.en: to say or write what something is like

example.en: Can you describe the route?
example.zh: 你能描述一下路线吗？

learning.watchOut: describe 用语言描述；depict 用图像或文字描绘。

definitions.en: words written or carved on something

example.en: The ring has a short inscription inside.
example.zh: 戒指内侧有一段短题词。

learning.coreIdea: 写或刻在某物上的文字。
learning.watchOut: inscription 是铭文；subscription 是订阅。

definitions.en: to change something into another form

example.en: The tool converts speech into text.
example.zh: 这个工具把语音转换成文字。

learning.watchOut: convert 是转换；convey 是传达或运输。

definitions.en: to return to a previous state

example.en: The system reverted to its old settings.
example.zh: 系统恢复到了旧设置。

learning.watchOut: revert to 后接旧状态；reply 是回复消息。

definitions.en: to prevent something bad or turn away

example.en: Quick action averted a crisis.
example.zh: 迅速行动避免了一场危机。

morphemes.note: historical form from ab/ad group; to refine later

learning.watchOut: avert 常接危机/危险；avoid 更普通。

definitions.en: to continue or move forward

example.en: After the check, we can proceed.
example.zh: 检查之后，我们可以继续进行。

learning.watchOut: proceed 是继续；precede 是在前。

definitions.en: to be greater than a limit or expectation

example.en: Demand exceeded supply.
example.zh: 需求超过了供应。

learning.watchOut: exceed 是超过；excel 是擅长。

definitions.en: to achieve success or come after someone

example.en: She succeeded through steady practice.
example.zh: 她通过稳定练习取得了成功。

learning.coreIdea: 跟着走到结果，后来表示成功或接替。
learning.watchOut: succeed in doing something；不要直接说 succeed to do。

definitions.en: to move back or become more distant

example.en: The floodwater began to recede.
example.zh: 洪水开始退去。

learning.watchOut: recede 是退去；reseed 是重新播种。

definitions.en: to lead, organize, or carry out

example.en: Researchers conducted a survey.
example.zh: 研究人员开展了一项调查。

learning.watchOut: conduct 作名词可指行为，作动词可指实施。

definitions.en: to formally bring someone into a role or group

example.en: The club inducted three new members.
example.zh: 俱乐部吸纳了三名新成员。

learning.watchOut: induct 是引入/就任；deduct 是扣除。

definitions.en: to make or bring something forth

example.en: The process produces less waste.
example.zh: 这个过程产生更少废料。

learning.watchOut: produce 作名词可指农产品，重音不同。

definitions.en: to make something smaller or less

example.en: Walking can reduce stress.
example.zh: 散步可以降低压力。

learning.watchOut: reduce 是减少；deduce 是推论。

definitions.en: able to be heard

example.en: Her voice was barely audible.
example.zh: 她的声音几乎听不见。

morphemes.note: suffix placeholder until suffix catalog is expanded

learning.memoryHook: aud + ible = able to be heard。
learning.watchOut: audible 是听得见；edible 是可食用。

definitions.en: the people who listen to or watch something

example.en: The speaker knew her audience well.
example.zh: 演讲者很了解她的听众。

learning.coreIdea: 正在听的人群，后来包括观众和受众。
learning.watchOut: audience 是受众；audition 是试镜/试听。

definitions.en: related to speech sounds

example.en: The dictionary includes phonetic symbols.
example.zh: 这本词典包含音标。

learning.watchOut: phonetic 偏语音学；phonics 偏自然拼读教学。

definitions.en: a long musical work for orchestra, or a harmonious combination

example.en: The orchestra performed a new symphony.
example.zh: 管弦乐队演奏了一首新交响曲。

learning.watchOut: symphony 是交响；sympathy 是共感。

definitions.en: a person's own signature

example.en: Fans waited for the actor's autograph.
example.zh: 粉丝等待演员的亲笔签名。

morphemes.note: auto root to be added if pilot expands self-family words

learning.watchOut: autograph 是签名；autobiography 是自传。

definitions.en: a written account of someone's life

example.en: The biography covers her early career.
example.zh: 这本传记讲述了她早期的职业生涯。

learning.coreIdea: 把一个人的生命经历写下来。
learning.watchOut: biography 是别人写的人生；autobiography 是自传。

definitions.en: the study of populations and their structure

example.en: Demography helps planners understand population change.
example.zh: 人口统计学帮助规划者理解人口变化。

learning.watchOut: demography 是人口研究；democracy 是民主制度。

definitions.en: an instrument for viewing very small objects

example.en: Students observed cells through a microscope.
example.zh: 学生通过显微镜观察细胞。

morphemes.note: scope root can be split later if more scope words are added

learning.memoryHook: micro + scope = look at small things。
learning.watchOut: microscope 看小物；microphone 收声音。

definitions.en: an instrument for viewing distant objects

example.en: The telescope revealed distant galaxies.
example.zh: 望远镜揭示了遥远的星系。

morphemes.note: scope root can be split later if more scope words are added

learning.watchOut: telescope 是望远镜；telegraph 是远距离书写/电报。

definitions.en: the order of events in time

example.en: The report gives a clear chronology of events.
example.zh: 报告给出了清晰的事件时间顺序。

learning.watchOut: chronology 是时间顺序；chronicle 是编年记录。

definitions.en: to make things happen at the same time

example.en: The app synchronizes data across devices.
example.zh: 这个应用在多台设备之间同步数据。

learning.watchOut: synchronize 是同步；synergize 是协同增效。

definitions.en: to subtract or take away from a total

example.en: The fee will be deducted from your account.
example.zh: 这笔费用将从你的账户中扣除。

learning.watchOut: deduct 是扣除；deduce 是推论。

definitions.sense: leading in, formal entry or reasoning
definitions.en: the act of bringing someone into a role, or reasoning from examples to a rule

example.en: The induction ceremony welcomed the new members.
example.zh: 入会仪式欢迎了新成员。

learning.coreIdea: 把人或想法引入某个体系，也可指从例子引出规则。
learning.memoryHook: in + duct + ion = leading in as an action/result.
learning.watchOut: induction 是引入或归纳；deduction 是扣除或演绎推理。

definitions.en: using particular examples to reach a general rule

example.en: Inductive reasoning moves from examples to a broader pattern.
example.zh: 归纳推理从例子走向更广泛的规律。

learning.memoryHook: in + duct + ive = tending to lead in/toward a rule.
learning.watchOut: inductive 是归纳的；deductive 是演绎的。

definitions.en: the act or result of making something smaller or less

example.en: The plan aims for a reduction in waste.
example.zh: 该计划旨在减少废弃物。

learning.coreIdea: 把数量带到更低后的过程或结果。
learning.memoryHook: re + duct + ion = leading down as a result.
learning.watchOut: reduction 是减少；deduction 是扣除或推论。

definitions.en: an amount taken away, or reasoning from a rule to a conclusion

example.en: Tax deductions lowered the final bill.
example.zh: 税务扣除降低了最终账单。

learning.coreIdea: 从总数中带走一部分，或从规则带出结论。
learning.memoryHook: de + duct + ion = leading away/down as a result.
learning.watchOut: deduction 是扣除或演绎；reduction 是减少；induction 是归纳。

definitions.en: able to be subtracted, or the amount paid before insurance covers costs

example.en: Some business expenses are deductible.
example.zh: 一些商业开支是可以扣除的。

learning.memoryHook: de + duct + ible = able to be led away from a total.
learning.watchOut: deductible 可作形容词，也可作保险中的免赔额名词。

definitions.en: to jump, rise, or appear suddenly

example.en: New shoots spring from the soil after rain.
example.zh: 雨后，新芽从土里冒出来。

definitions.en: the season when plants begin to grow again

example.en: The garden is full of color in spring.
example.zh: 春天，花园里满是色彩。

definitions.en: a natural place where water flows up from the ground

example.en: The village grew around a clear mountain spring.
example.zh: 村庄围绕一处清澈的山泉发展起来。

definitions.en: a coil or device that returns after being pressed or stretched

example.en: The spring pushed the lid back open.
example.zh: 弹簧把盖子又弹开了。

learning.coreIdea: 某物带着力量突然冒出、跃起、涌出或弹回。
learning.memoryHook: spring 的画面不是“春天”本身，而是生命、水或物体突然 spring forth。
learning.watchOut: spring 的几个常见名词义是同一词的多义 sense，不要拆成多个 derivative tab。

definitions.en: a system of steps or marks used to measure size, amount, or level

example.en: The map uses a scale of one inch to ten miles.
example.zh: 这张地图使用一英寸代表十英里的比例尺。

definitions.en: a thin shell-like plate on a fish, reptile, or surface

example.en: The fish had bright silver scales.
example.zh: 这条鱼有亮银色的鳞片。

definitions.en: an instrument for weighing things

example.en: She put the package on the scale.
example.zh: 她把包裹放在秤上。

definitions.en: to climb up or over something steep

example.en: The hikers scaled the cliff before noon.
example.zh: 徒步者在中午前攀上了悬崖。

definitions.en: to change size or amount proportionally

example.en: The app can scale the image without distortion.
example.zh: 这个应用可以无失真地按比例缩放图片。

morphemes.meaning: shell plate; weighing pan from a split-shell image
morphemes.note: fish-scale and weighing-scale branch

morphemes.meaning: ladder, steps; graded measure or climb
morphemes.note: measure/climb branch

learning.coreIdea: scale 是一个同形交汇点：一条线是壳片/鳞片/天平盘，一条线是阶梯/刻度/攀登。
learning.memoryHook: scale 可以想成“片”和“级”：鳞片是一片片，刻度和攀登是一阶阶。
learning.watchOut: scale 有同形多源风险；不要把鱼鳞、天平、刻度和攀登硬讲成单一现代词根。

definitions.en: a first version of a piece of writing or a plan

example.en: Please send me the first draft of your essay.
example.zh: 请把你的论文初稿发给我。

definitions.en: to choose people for military service, a team, or a task

example.en: The team drafted a young quarterback.
example.zh: 球队选中了一名年轻四分卫。

definitions.en: a current of air moving through a space

example.en: A cold draft came under the door.
example.zh: 一阵冷风从门缝里钻进来。

definitions.sense: drawn from a cask or tap
definitions.en: served by being drawn from a cask or tap

example.en: They ordered draft beer with dinner.
example.zh: 他们晚餐时点了生啤。

definitions.en: a written order to pay money from one account to another

example.en: The invoice was paid by bank draft.
example.zh: 这张发票是用银行汇票支付的。

learning.coreIdea: draft 的多义围绕 draw：拉出一股空气、汲出啤酒、抽调人员、先拉出一版文字。
learning.memoryHook: 草稿是先 draw 出来的版本；生啤是从桶里 draw 出来的酒；征兵是把人 draw off 出来。
learning.watchOut: draft 和 draught 在英美用法中分工不同；drift 是“漂移”，不是 draft。

definitions.en: to strive against others for a goal, prize, market, or advantage

example.en: Several teams compete for the championship.
example.zh: 几支队伍争夺冠军。

learning.coreIdea: 和别人一起追求同一个目标，于是形成竞争。
learning.memoryHook: com + pete = together + seek：大家都朝同一个奖品伸手。
learning.watchOut: compete 是竞争；complete 是完成；competent 是有能力的，不等于 competitive。

definitions.en: rivalry or a contest in which people try to win the same goal

example.en: The competition attracted students from many schools.
example.zh: 这场比赛吸引了许多学校的学生。

definitions.en: the people or companies competing against someone

example.en: The company lowered prices to beat the competition.
example.zh: 公司降价以击败竞争对手。

learning.coreIdea: 多人或多方同时追求同一个目标的过程或局面。
learning.watchOut: competition 是竞争；composition 是组成或作文，拼写相近但词根路径不同。

definitions.en: involving competition or rivalry

example.en: The market is highly competitive.
example.zh: 这个市场竞争非常激烈。

definitions.en: eager to compete or strong enough to compete well

example.en: She is competitive but fair.
example.zh: 她好胜但公平。

morphemes.meaning: having the nature of, tending to

learning.coreIdea: 具有竞争性质，或有争胜倾向。
learning.memoryHook: competitive = having the nature of compete。
learning.watchOut: competitive 是竞争性的；competent 是胜任的、能力足够的。

definitions.en: a person, team, or company that competes

example.en: Each competitor presented a different design.
example.zh: 每个参赛者都展示了不同的设计。

learning.coreIdea: 和别人追求同一目标的人、队伍或公司。
learning.memoryHook: competitor = a person or group that competes。
learning.watchOut: competitor 是竞争者；competent 是有能力的。

definitions.en: to get or take something that is given, sent, or offered

example.en: I received your message this morning.
example.zh: 我今天早上收到了你的信息。

definitions.en: to welcome someone or allow someone to enter

example.en: The host received the guests at the door.
example.zh: 主人在门口接待客人。

definitions.en: to accept something as true or experience an effect, injury, or treatment

example.en: The proposal received strong support.
example.zh: 这个提议得到了强烈支持。

morphemes.note: Latin re- in recipere has an unclear exact force here, but keeps the back/take-in image.
From Latin recipere, with -cipere as a combining form of capere.

learning.coreIdea: 把给出、送来、进入的东西接到自己这边。
learning.memoryHook: re + ceive = take in/back：东西从外面被接进来。
learning.watchOut: receive 是接收；recipe 是配方；receipt 是收据，三者同源但现代用法分开。

definitions.en: the act or manner of receiving someone or something

example.en: The speaker received a warm reception.
example.zh: 演讲者受到了热烈欢迎。

definitions.en: a reception desk or a formal social gathering

example.en: Please check in at reception.
example.zh: 请在接待处登记。

definitions.en: the quality of received radio, phone, or television signals

example.en: Cell phone reception is weak here.
example.zh: 这里手机信号接收很弱。

morphemes.note: From Latin receptio/receptus, built on recipere/capere.

learning.coreIdea: 接收这个动作、场景或结果。
learning.watchOut: reception 是接待/接收；recession 是衰退；recipe 是配方。

definitions.en: willing or able to receive ideas, suggestions, signals, or impressions

example.en: The audience was receptive to the new idea.
example.zh: 观众愿意接受这个新想法。

morphemes.note: From Latin receptus/recipere, from capere.

morphemes.meaning: having the nature of, tending to

learning.coreIdea: 具有接收、接受或响应的倾向。
learning.memoryHook: receptive = having the nature of receiving。
learning.watchOut: receptive 是乐于接受；respective 是各自的；perceptive 是有洞察力的。

definitions.en: a person or thing that receives something

example.en: The receiver signed for the package.
example.zh: 收件人签收了包裹。

definitions.en: a device that receives signals, sound, or information

example.en: The radio receiver picked up a clear signal.
example.zh: 无线电接收器接收到清晰信号。

morphemes.note: English receive plus agent suffix.
Using the existing agent suffix entry; receiver is the one/thing that receives.

learning.coreIdea: 接收动作的执行者或接收装置。
learning.watchOut: receiver 常指设备或收件人；recipient 更偏正式地指收到某物的人。

definitions.en: a written or electronic record showing that money or goods were received

example.en: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the item.
example.zh: 保留收据，以防需要退货。

definitions.en: the act or fact of receiving something

example.en: Payment is due upon receipt of the invoice.
example.zh: 收到发票后即应付款。

morphemes.note: The restored written p points back to Latin recipere/recepta, though it is silent in modern pronunciation.

learning.coreIdea: 收到这件事留下的凭证，或收到这个动作本身。
learning.memoryHook: receipt 里的 p 是历史拼写影子：写出来提醒 capere/recipere，读音里不发。
learning.watchOut: receipt 是收据；recipe 是配方；receive 是动词“收到”。

definitions.en: a person or group that receives something

example.en: The scholarship recipient thanked the committee.
example.zh: 奖学金获得者感谢了委员会。

morphemes.note: From Latin recipiens/recipient-, present participle of recipere.

learning.coreIdea: 处在接收位置上的人或群体。
learning.memoryHook: recipient = the one receiving; cip keeps the Latin capere/recipere family visible.
learning.watchOut: recipient 比 receiver 更正式；receiver 也可指设备。

definitions.en: to leave someone or something behind or give up an effort

example.en: The team refused to abandon the project.
example.zh: 团队拒绝放弃这个项目。

definitions.en: a free or uncontrolled way of behaving

example.en: The children danced with abandon.
example.zh: 孩子们尽情地跳舞。

learning.coreIdea: 放开控制权，不再继续守住。
learning.memoryHook: abandon = give up control and leave it behind。
learning.watchOut: 注意名词 abandon 表示放纵，不等于 abandonment。

definitions.en: left and no longer used, wanted, or cared for

example.en: They found an abandoned cabin near the road.
example.zh: 他们在路边发现了一间废弃小屋。

learning.coreIdea: 被放弃后留下来的状态。
learning.watchOut: abandoned 可形容地点、物品或人，也可有情感色彩。

definitions.en: the act of leaving or giving something up

example.en: The plan's abandonment surprised investors.
example.zh: 这个计划被放弃让投资者感到意外。

learning.watchOut: 和 abandon 的名词义“放纵”不同，abandonment 更强调抛弃/放弃。

definitions.en: to shorten a word, phrase, text, or process

example.en: Please abbreviate the title in the chart.
example.zh: 请在图表中缩写标题。

learning.watchOut: 不要和 alleviate 混淆；abbreviate 是缩短，不是减轻。

definitions.en: a shortened form of a word or phrase

example.en: NASA is an abbreviation.
example.zh: NASA 是一个缩写。

learning.watchOut: abbreviation 指缩写形式；acronym 特指按字母读或成词的缩略词。

definitions.en: to accept and follow a rule or decision

example.en: All members must abide by the rules.
example.zh: 所有成员都必须遵守规则。

definitions.en: to tolerate or endure something

example.en: She cannot abide unfair treatment.
example.zh: 她无法忍受不公平待遇。

learning.coreIdea: 留下来承受规则或状态。
learning.memoryHook: abide by = stay with and obey。
learning.watchOut: abide 常和 by 搭配表示遵守；作“忍受”时多用于否定。

definitions.en: continuing for a long time

example.en: He has an abiding interest in history.
example.zh: 他对历史有持久的兴趣。

learning.watchOut: abiding 多修饰 interest, faith, influence 等抽象名词。

definitions.en: the power, skill, or capacity to do something

example.en: The test measures reading ability.
example.zh: 这项测试衡量阅读能力。

learning.watchOut: ability 泛指能力；capability 更强调可发挥的能力或性能。

definitions.en: the state of not being able to do something

example.en: His inability to focus hurt his performance.
example.zh: 他无法集中注意力影响了表现。

learning.watchOut: inability 后常接 to do。

definitions.en: the ability or capacity to do, contain, or achieve something

example.en: The device has expanded storage capability.
example.zh: 这台设备扩展了存储能力。

learning.coreIdea: 能够抓住任务、承载容量或完成事情。
learning.memoryHook: capability has cap: the capacity to hold or do.
learning.watchOut: capability 强调可实现能力；capacity 更偏容量或承载量。

definitions.en: the ability to live, continue, or succeed

example.en: The study tested the plan's viability.
example.zh: 这项研究检验了计划的可行性。

learning.coreIdea: 能活下去或行得通的状态。
learning.memoryHook: viability = life/able/ity: able to live or work.
learning.watchOut: viable 是形容词；viability 是名词。

definitions.en: the quality of being likely or able to vary

example.en: Climate variability affects crop yields.
example.zh: 气候可变性会影响作物产量。

learning.memoryHook: variability = the quality of being variable.
learning.watchOut: variability 是可变性；variety 是种类多样性。

definitions.en: burning, brightly lit, or shining strongly

example.en: The sky was ablaze at sunset.
example.zh: 日落时天空一片灿烂。

learning.watchOut: ablaze 通常作表语：the room was ablaze。

definitions.en: burning fiercely or shining very brightly

example.en: They walked under the blazing sun.
example.zh: 他们走在烈日下。

learning.coreIdea: 像火焰一样持续发亮或发热。
learning.watchOut: blazing 可指火、光、太阳，也可指速度很快。

definitions.en: different from what is usual, expected, or normal

example.en: The scan showed abnormal results.
example.zh: 扫描显示结果异常。

learning.watchOut: abnormal 可用于医学或统计语境，语气比 unusual 更正式。

definitions.en: usual, regular, or according to a standard

example.en: Her temperature returned to normal.
example.zh: 她的体温恢复正常。

learning.watchOut: normal 是中性词；ordinary 更偏普通。

definitions.en: to officially end a law, system, or practice

example.en: The law abolished the old tax.
example.zh: 这项法律废除了旧税制。

learning.coreIdea: 把制度或做法彻底取消。
learning.watchOut: abolish 多用于制度、法律；cancel 更宽泛。

definitions.en: the act of officially ending a law, system, or practice

example.en: The abolition of the rule took years.
example.zh: 这条规则的废除花了多年。

learning.watchOut: 历史语境中 abolition 常特指废奴。

definitions.en: a person who worked to end slavery or supports abolishing a system

example.en: The abolitionist spoke against slavery.
example.zh: 这位废奴主义者发表演讲反对奴隶制。

learning.watchOut: 最常见含义是废奴主义者，但结构上也可指支持废除某制度的人。

definitions.en: to stop a plan, process, or mission before it is completed

example.en: The crew had to abort the launch.
example.zh: 工作人员不得不中止发射。

learning.coreIdea: 在事情成形前让它停止。
learning.memoryHook: abort = stop before it fully comes into being。
learning.watchOut: 现代常作动词；Excel 中列为名词义时可理解为中止任务的行为。

definitions.en: to exist in large numbers or amounts

example.en: Wildflowers abound in the valley.
example.zh: 山谷里野花遍布。

learning.watchOut: abound 常与 in/with 搭配。

definitions.en: damage caused by scraping or rubbing a surface

example.en: The helmet had signs of abrasion.
example.zh: 头盔有磨损痕迹。

learning.watchOut: abrasion 是磨损结果；abrasive 是会磨损的材料或态度。

definitions.en: able to scrape surfaces, or harsh in manner

example.en: The cleaner contains abrasive particles.
example.zh: 这种清洁剂含有研磨颗粒。

learning.watchOut: abrasive 也可形容人说话刺耳。

definitions.en: sudden, unexpected, or seeming rudely brief

example.en: The meeting came to an abrupt end.
example.zh: 会议突然结束了。

learning.watchOut: abrupt 可指变化突然，也可指态度生硬。

definitions.en: frequent absence from school or work

example.en: The company tried to reduce absenteeism.
example.zh: 公司试图减少旷工现象。

learning.coreIdea: 缺席变成一种反复现象。
learning.memoryHook: absenteeism = the condition/practice of being absent.
learning.watchOut: absenteeism 指旷课/旷工现象，不是一次 absence。

definitions.en: a person who is not present where expected

example.en: Absentees must submit the form later.
example.zh: 缺席者必须稍后提交表格。

learning.watchOut: absentee 可用于 absentee ballot，指缺席投票相关。

definitions.en: not present, or missing from a place or situation

example.en: Several students were absent today.
example.zh: 今天有几名学生缺席。

learning.watchOut: absent-minded 是心不在焉，不只是缺席。

definitions.en: the state of being away or not present

example.en: Her absence was noticed immediately.
example.zh: 她的缺席立刻被注意到了。

learning.memoryHook: absence = the state of being absent。
learning.watchOut: absence 可指人不在，也可指某物缺乏。

definitions.en: complete, total, or not limited by conditions

example.en: The ruler claimed absolute power.
example.zh: 统治者声称拥有绝对权力。

learning.coreIdea: 从限制中解开，所以不受条件限制。
learning.watchOut: absolute 可表示完全，也可表示绝对不依赖外物。

definitions.en: completely or without qualification

example.en: You are absolutely right.
example.zh: 你完全正确。

learning.watchOut: 口语中 absolutely 也可表示强烈同意。

definitions.en: to take in liquid, energy, information, or attention

example.en: Plants absorb water through their roots.
example.zh: 植物通过根吸收水分。

learning.watchOut: absorb 是吸收进入内部；adsorb 是吸附在表面。

definitions.en: the process of taking in liquid, energy, or information

example.en: The material improves sound absorption.
example.zh: 这种材料改善吸音效果。

learning.watchOut: 注意 absorption 和 adsorption 拼写及含义不同。

definitions.en: existing as an idea rather than a physical thing

example.en: Justice is an abstract concept.
example.zh: 正义是一个抽象概念。

definitions.en: a short summary, or to draw out the main idea

example.en: The article begins with an abstract.
example.zh: 这篇文章以摘要开头。

learning.coreIdea: 从具体事物中抽离出核心。
learning.memoryHook: abstract = draw away from the concrete。
learning.watchOut: abstract 作名词是摘要；作形容词是抽象的。

definitions.en: so unreasonable that it seems ridiculous

example.en: The claim was absurd.
example.zh: 这个说法很荒谬。

learning.coreIdea: 偏离理性到听不进去道理。
learning.memoryHook: absurd = away from reason or sense。
learning.watchOut: absurd 语气较强，常指不合逻辑到可笑。

definitions.en: available in large quantities

example.en: The region has abundant rainfall.
example.zh: 该地区雨水充沛。

learning.watchOut: abundant 常修饰 resources, evidence, rainfall。

definitions.en: in a plentiful or very clear way

example.en: The data make the point abundantly clear.
example.zh: 数据把这一点说明得非常清楚。

learning.coreIdea: 以丰富或非常明显的方式。
learning.watchOut: abundantly clear 是常见搭配。

definitions.en: a very large quantity of something

example.en: The forest provides an abundance of food.
example.zh: 森林提供大量食物。

learning.watchOut: an abundance of 后接不可数或复数名词。

definitions.en: to use wrongly or treat someone cruelly

example.en: Officials must not abuse their power.
example.zh: 官员不得滥用权力。

learning.coreIdea: 偏离正常使用，或错误对待人。
learning.memoryHook: abuse = use away from the proper use。
learning.watchOut: abuse 可指滥用权力，也可指虐待。

definitions.en: to touch or border on something

example.en: The garden abuts the river.
example.zh: 花园紧邻河流。

learning.memoryHook: abut = touch at the end or border。
learning.watchOut: abut 是正式词；about 是介词/副词，拼写相近但不同。

definitions.en: related to schools, scholarship, or theoretical study

example.en: The article uses an academic style.
example.zh: 这篇文章使用学术风格。

learning.coreIdea: 与学院和学术研究有关。
learning.watchOut: academic 也可表示理论上的、非实际的。

definitions.en: a member of an academy or a scholar

example.en: The academician presented new research.
example.zh: 这位院士展示了新的研究。

learning.coreIdea: 属于学术机构或学术领域的人。
learning.watchOut: 在不同国家 academician 的制度含义可能不同。

definitions.en: to make something happen faster or move faster

example.en: The new policy may accelerate growth.
example.zh: 新政策可能加速增长。

learning.watchOut: accelerate 可及物也可不及物。

definitions.en: made faster or occurring faster than usual

example.en: The school offers an accelerated program.
example.zh: 学校提供加速课程。

learning.watchOut: accelerated program 指压缩或加快进度的课程。

definitions.en: increasing in speed or pace

example.en: They faced accelerating costs.
example.zh: 他们面临不断加速上涨的成本。

learning.watchOut: accelerating 可修饰增长、成本、变化等。

definitions.en: an increase in speed, or the rate of that increase

example.en: The car's acceleration was impressive.
example.zh: 这辆车的加速性能令人印象深刻。

learning.coreIdea: 速度增加这个过程或程度。
learning.memoryHook: acceleration = the process/rate of speeding up。
learning.watchOut: 物理中 acceleration 指加速度；日常语境可指加快。

definitions.en: the opportunity or right to approach, enter, or use something

example.en: Students need access to reliable internet.
example.zh: 学生需要能使用可靠的互联网。

definitions.en: a way of entering or reaching a place

example.en: The building has wheelchair access.
example.zh: 这栋楼有轮椅通道。

learning.coreIdea: 走到某处并获得使用或进入机会。
learning.memoryHook: access = a way to go toward or enter。
learning.watchOut: access 是接近/使用机会；excess 是过量。

definitions.zh: 可接近的；可接触的；可得到的
definitions.en: easy to reach, enter, use, understand, or obtain

example.en: The museum is accessible by subway.
example.zh: 这个博物馆可以乘地铁到达。

learning.coreIdea: 可以被到达、进入或理解。
learning.watchOut: accessible 也常表示无障碍或易懂。

definitions.en: the quality of being easy to reach, use, understand, or obtain

example.en: The redesign improved accessibility.
example.zh: 重新设计提升了可达性。

learning.coreIdea: 容易被到达或使用的性质。
learning.watchOut: 技术和建筑语境中常指无障碍性。

definitions.en: an extra item that is useful but not essential

example.en: The case is sold as a phone accessory.
example.zh: 这个保护壳作为手机配件出售。

learning.coreIdea: 附加到主体旁边的东西。
learning.memoryHook: accessory = something that goes along with another thing。
learning.watchOut: accessory 不等于 access；法律上 accessory 也可指从犯。
